class.name: SteamListing
class.brief_description: A detached Steam discovery or invite snapshot. Join through the current game to resolve it.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Return the Steam AppID under which the listing was observed.

method.name: get_namespace
method.description: Return the game namespace expected by this listing.

method.name: get_world_id
method.description: Return the advertised world identifier when available.

method.name: get_players
method.description: Return the observed lobby member count, or zero without a count.

method.name: get_capacity
method.description: Return the observed lobby member limit, or zero without a limit.

method.name: get_server_steam_id
method.description: Return the Steam server identity when present. Lobby locators return an empty string.

method.name: get_ping_ms
method.description: Return the measured server latency in milliseconds, or minus one when unavailable.

method.name: is_social
method.description: Return true when Steam metadata identified a standalone social lobby. A thin invite locator may need to join Steam membership before the selected flow can verify its type.

members.member: Steam AppID under which the listing was observed.
Expected game namespace for fresh resolution.

constants.constant: Reserved listing kind for Steam server discovery.
